saw_lines: Orthopedic shoe buyers search in pain, so they trust other people with the same problem more than the brand.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides whether the shoe fits their foot problem.
Your site shows 400,000+ reviews, yet only 4 of 28 live ads use a site proof number. Put 400,000+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 400,000+ reviews, but only 4 of 28 live ads carry a site proof number, so buyers miss the strongest reason to trust you. Put 400,000+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a diabetic customer’s quote.
7 of your 22 copy ads run the same text, so a viewer who saw one sees them all. Keep the body copy, but rewrite the opening line and swap the image on each so they read as new ads.
8 of your 22 copy ads open on “there was a time when”, so the same story repeats. Test two new angles: a price answer using your HSA and FSA FAQ page, and a customer quote about the first week.
Your 7 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so someone who clicks a shoe in the creative has to search for it again. Point each one to the product page for the exact shoe the image shows.

ads_1: Diabetic review quotes and HSA cost angles, with 400,000+ reviews on the creative
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Twitter and YouTube
